sentences.en: Parents are always worried about the future of their children.
sentences.zh: 父母总是担心孩子的未来。

sentences.en: The world's aviation industry is growing increasingly worried about crashes.
sentences.zh: 世界航空业对坠机事件越来越感到担忧。

sentences.en: First of all, he is very worried about his daughter's health.
sentences.zh: 首先，他非常担心女儿的健康。

senses.zh: 焦虑的,烦恼的,担忧的非常担心；焦虑过度(误会所致)你让我虛惊一场
